text:
lea_sales: Heads-up  Apollo Health just escalated. CTO wants guaranteed p95 < 150ms for a customer demo tomorrow. Also asked for SSO + a short reserved window and confirmation of zero public egress during the demo. Need an internal plan + one-paragraph exec briefing by EOD.

omar_se: Can someone paste the exact numbers they're seeing from their traces? I want to repro from our relay.

tanya_cs: They shared a sanitized run: `POST /v1/generate 256 tokens p95=410ms tail=890ms` from a VM in their VPC hitting our Private relay. They noted spikes during bursts (~QPS 10).

liam_eng: Two likely levers: (1) connection pooling at the relay to avoid per-request TCP/TLS churn, and (2) force a small batch window so the batcher aggregates short inter-arrival requests. Short mitigation: spin up a 12h Dedicated window with `min_replicas=2` and `batch_window_ms=20` in their VPC. NVMe cache optional for extra benefit.

vivian_ops: Ops can stand up the Dedicated window and apply strict security groups + route tables to block public egress. Estimate infra delta for 12h (2xA10 equiv + ops premium) ~ "$1,750" before credits. We can apply POC credit if Sales requests it.

lea_sales: Head_of_sales wants a recommended concession amount. If we offer a 25% credit on the window, what's the net?

vivian_ops: Net w/ 25% credit -> ~$1,312. I'll prepare a short breakdown.

omar_se: I'll run a repro from our side via infra-bot: `infra-bot: run-probe --target apollo-vpc --qps 10 --burst 20 --duration 300 --path /v1/generate` and attach traces.

infra-bot: Probe scheduled  id `probe-3223456789-01`.

omar_se: Sanity check from my local lab: baseline p95 ~410ms. After enabling connection pooling + `batch_window_ms=20` p95 -> ~150ms. NVMe gave additional ~10% improvement in p95.

lea_sales: Good. Legal: any blockers to granting SSO for demo-only access? We need a minimal addendum and scoped service account.

legal-bot: Recommend a short addendum + demo-only service account with console read-only and no billing privileges. NDA/email approval required before granting access. I'll draft and circulate.

vivian_ops: Canary config ready. Will only proceed after signed addendum and sales approval on credits.

omar_se: Traces uploaded: https://redwood-internal/trace/3223456789 (sanitized). Canary run p95 =~148ms, p99 =~220ms, tail max ~310ms. NVMe lowered p95 to ~132ms.

tanya_cs: I've started filling their security questionnaire; outstanding clarifications: BYO-KMS support and NVMe persistence policy for demo data.

lea_sales: BYO-KMS? can we support it for a Private demo?

liam_eng: We support BYO-KMS under Private with limited integration steps and ops checklist. For a short demo window we can accept ephemeral keys or a delegated key policy; legal should sign off.

legal-bot: I'll add approved BYO-KMS language to the addendum. NVMe persistence must be documented as ephemeral and wiped after the demo.

lea_sales: Action items: @vivian_ops prepare cost breakdown and canary config; @omar_se attach final traces and monitoring; @legal-bot draft addendum + BYO-KMS language; @tanya_cs finish questionnaire answers. I will compile the one-paragraph exec note after numbers are in.

infra-bot: Ticket INF-3223456789 created. Status: awaiting-addendum.

vivian_ops: Cost breakdown posted to internal doc and linked in thread.

lea_sales: I'll send the exec note to Head of Sales in 45m. If we get sign-off we'll schedule the Dedicated window and run the demo canary with verbose logging.

omar_se: I'll standby for the rollout and monitor metrics during the demo.

infra-bot: Canary scheduled  id `canary-3223456789-01`.
